territories.name: Kiribati
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Kiribati levies a value added tax of its own under the Value Added Tax Act 2013: the Tax Division of the Ministry of Finance and Economic Development sets the rate at 12.5 per cent, the schedules zero-rate exports and the other supplies they list and exempt the supplies they list, and a registered person files a quarterly return with the Division.
